formal_checkpoint_selection: epoch-15 last.pt for all 12 formal cells; no best-epoch cherry-picking

predict_runtime_path.nms_cells: A/C: 6/6 models, 16/16 traced calls per model reach the suppression kernel
predict_runtime_path.end2end_cells: B/D: 6/6 models, 16/16 traced calls per model use end2end_score_filter; suppression kernel calls are zero

deterministic_resources.input: finite all-zero float32 [1,3,640,640], two THOP repetitions

cpu_latency.measurement: CPU, 4 Torch/OpenCV threads, affinity 28-31; 3 seeds x 4 cells x (50 warmup + 200 timed samples)
cpu_latency.scope: RAM image -> preprocess -> inference -> postprocess -> Results; excludes model loading and disk I/O
cpu_latency.interpretation: Both end-to-end comparisons are measurably lower under the locked protocol, but below 0.4 percent and not a material speedup claim.
